title: Profiles on a shared TV
description: Serves "Joining and signing in are easy and safe."; "They see only what they may.". The owner: shared-TV profiles with an optional PIN (D-143). Octave builds the screens (ASK-8).
acceptanceCriteria: A TV holds the profiles of the household that were added to it, each approved by that person or the operator, and switches between them without signing in again.
Each profile has its own history, languages, access and limits; nothing of one profile shows in another.
A profile can ask for a PIN before it opens. The PIN is stored hashed, guessing it is bounded, and it is a parental gate, not a sign-in: docs/access.md says so.
Removing a profile from a TV, or signing the TV out, ends that profile there at once, through any replica.
Every capability it adds is in the published contract (JS-183) and passes its conformance check.
